text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I’d be glad to build your jewelry designer landing page using the provided Themeforest static HTML template. I’m comfortable working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and clean responsive layouts, and I can structure up to ten sections including a gallery so the site feels polished and elegant.

One relevant project was a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. That work reduced largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and helped organic traffic grow by 38% in 3 months.

I’d be happy to deliver a clean, fast static landing page that fits your brand and uses the supplied template efficiently.
